test_cases.name: trigger-slash-command
test_cases.description: Skill triggers on the exact slash command
assertions: User sees mode selection: Create New vs Add Existing
No file writes or DB changes occur at this stage

test_cases.name: trigger-natural-create
test_cases.prompt: I want to create a new project
test_cases.description: Skill triggers on natural language create request
assertions: Skill activates and enters wizard flow
User is not treated as a generic conversation

test_cases.name: trigger-natural-register
test_cases.prompt: I want to register an existing project in MultiTerminal
test_cases.description: Skill triggers on register/add existing intent
assertions: Flow steers toward Add Existing path

test_cases.name: trigger-technology-specific
test_cases.prompt: I want to start a new Clarion COM control
test_cases.description: Skill triggers on technology-specific project creation
assertions: Skill activates (not treated as generic Clarion question)
Clarion COM archetype should be suggested or pre-selected

test_cases.name: no-trigger-query
test_cases.prompt: What projects are registered in MultiTerminal?
test_cases.description: Skill should NOT trigger on project queries
assertions: Agent answers with project list or DB query

test_cases.name: no-trigger-edit
test_cases.prompt: Update the deploy path for the MultiTerminal project
test_cases.description: Skill should NOT trigger on project modification
assertions: Agent handles as direct DB update

test_cases.name: create-clarion-com
test_cases.description: Full Create New flow for Clarion COM with all defaults

user_responses.name: ClarionGrid
user_responses.description: A custom grid control for Clarion

assertions: Git repo initialized on 'main' branch with initial commit
projects.json registry contains entry with matching ID
SQLite: project_paths has source path entry

test_cases.name: create-generic-csharp
test_cases.description: Create New flow for Generic C# class library

test_cases.name: create-multiterminal-feature
test_cases.description: Create New flow for MultiTerminal Feature
assertions: deploy_path set to the resolved MT Deploy directory (<DEPLOY_PATH>), not a hardcoded H:\ path
Skips git init if .git already exists

test_cases.name: add-existing-dotnet-sln
test_cases.description: Add Existing for .NET project with .sln file
assertions: SQLite has git_repo_url from discovered remote

test_cases.name: add-existing-nodejs
test_cases.description: Add Existing for Node.js project with package.json
assertions: Archetype suggestion is 'Generic C# (with node adjustments)'

test_cases.name: add-existing-empty-folder
test_cases.description: Add Existing with empty folder
assertions: Folder name used as fallback PROJECT_NAME

test_cases.name: dialog-launch-case-a
test_cases.description: Dialog launch with pre-filled data, empty folder (Case A)
assertions: Step 1 asks description only, not name
PROJECT_ID reused from dialog (no new GUID)
ON CONFLICT handles pre-existing SQLite record

test_cases.name: dialog-launch-api-fail
test_cases.description: Dialog launch but REST API unreachable

test_cases.name: dialog-launch-case-b
test_cases.description: Dialog launch, folder has existing project files (Case B)
assertions: Skips to Step E2 (Add Existing auto-discovery)
Step E1 path input never shown

test_cases.name: edge-sql-injection
test_cases.description: Project name with apostrophe (SQL injection test)
assertions: All user-supplied fields escaped with '' for single quotes

test_cases.name: edge-path-not-exist
test_cases.description: Add Existing with non-existent path
assertions: Clear error message about missing path
Offers to retry or switch to Create New
User can re-enter path without restarting

test_cases.name: edge-already-registered
test_cases.description: Project path already registered in SQLite
assertions: Duplicate detected via SQLite query (checks path and source_path)
User warned with existing project name and ID

test_cases.name: edge-project-json-exists
test_cases.description: Folder already has .claude/project.json
assertions: createdAt, changeLog, prompts preserved from original

test_cases.name: edge-no-git
test_cases.description: Git not installed or not on PATH
assertions: Git failure does not block Steps 12-13
Project files and DB records created successfully

test_cases.name: error-sqlite-locked
test_cases.description: SQLite database locked during Step 12
assertions: Three-tier fallback: MCP tool -> sqlite3 CLI -> skip

test_cases.name: error-mcp-unavailable
test_cases.description: MCP tools unavailable (GUID generator, SQLite)

test_cases.name: error-permission-denied
test_cases.description: Filesystem permission denied on folder creation
assertions: No orphan DB records for failed folder
User can retry with different path

test_cases.name: error-start-over
test_cases.description: User selects 'Start over' in Step 6
assertions: No files or DB records from first pass

test_cases.name: error-refinement-loop
test_cases.description: Multiple refinement changes before approval
assertions: Each change reflected in re-displayed proposal
Final creation uses last refined values
DB records match refined values, not defaults
